concerns.location: plan.md Phase 1 / T003 — synthetic observational stand-in generation
concerns.text: The stand-in's generating distribution is unspecified. If it is drawn from the same 'Power-law mass with independent spin' generator as the sim catalog (T004), the KS test in pipeline-verification mode can only ever return 'no divergence' — a circular plumbing check that cannot detect a test implementation that is broken toward the null. Specify that the stand-in is drawn from a DIFFERENT, documented distribution (e.g., a different mass index or correlated spins) so the verification run exercises both significant and non-significant paths.

concerns.location: plan.md T006 / research.md 'Statistical Methodology' item 2 — event-level bootstrap
concerns.text: The plan specifies the bootstrap distribution of KS statistics but never states how the final reported p_value is derived from it (e.g., percentile of the observed statistic, or bootstrap-calibrated tail probability). Different choices give different calibration; the result schema requires a single p_value. Specify the estimator.

concerns.location: plan.md T008 / FR-010, FR-015 — MDES for a KS test
concerns.text: MDES is a mean-difference/regression concept; there is no standard 'minimum detectable effect size' for a two-sample KS test. As written, the MDES number is either undefined or a disguised power identity. Either define the effect size metric explicitly (e.g., detectable Kolmogorov distance D at 80% power via the asymptotic √(n_eff) relation) and name it as such, or replace with a KS-specific power calculation.

concerns.location: plan.md T004 — 'power-law mass index in a typical astrophysical range'
concerns.text: The comparison target is a specific parameterization, not the model class; rejection/acceptance is conditional on the chosen index and spin bounds. State the exact pinned parameter values (or that they are pinned at implementation with the seed) and note in the final report that conclusions are conditional on this parameterization.
